description: Migrate from deprecated @vercel/kv to @upstash/redis for AMPRE listing storage

userStories.title: Swap @vercel/kv for @upstash/redis in package.json
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to replace the deprecated @vercel/kv package with @upstash/redis so that the project uses a supported storage backend.
acceptanceCriteria: Remove @vercel/kv from frontend/package.json dependencies
Add @upstash/redis to frontend/package.json dependencies
Run npm install from the project root to update the lockfile
Grep for @vercel/kv in frontend/package.json returns zero results
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: This is an npm workspaces monorepo — run npm install from root, not from frontend/

userStories.title: Migrate sync route from @vercel/kv to @upstash/redis
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the AMPRE sync cron job to write listings and audit logs to Upstash Redis instead of Vercel KV.
acceptanceCriteria: frontend/src/app/api/ampre/sync/route.ts imports Redis from @upstash/redis instead of kv from @vercel/kv
Redis client is instantiated via Redis.fromEnv()
All kv.set() calls replaced with redis.set() calls
All kv.get() calls replaced with redis.get() calls
TTL for sync log entries preserved (90 days = 90 * 24 * 60 * 60 seconds)
No references to @vercel/kv remain in the file
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: @upstash/redis auto-serializes JSON like @vercel/kv did — no need for JSON.stringify

userStories.title: Migrate fetch layer from @vercel/kv to @upstash/redis
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the listing fetch functions to read from Upstash Redis instead of Vercel KV.
acceptanceCriteria: frontend/src/lib/ampre/fetch.ts no longer imports from @vercel/kv
Redis client instantiated via Redis.fromEnv() from @upstash/redis
isKvConfigured() checks UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_URL and UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_TOKEN instead of KV_REST_API_URL and KV_REST_API_TOKEN
getAllListingsFromKV() uses redis.get() instead of kv.get()
Dynamic import removed — use static import of Redis from @upstash/redis
No references to @vercel/kv remain in the file
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: The dynamic import pattern (await import('@vercel/kv')) was used for tree-shaking — @upstash/redis can use a normal static import since Redis.fromEnv() handles missing env vars gracefully

userStories.title: Update env var names and compliance constants
userStories.description: As a developer, I need environment variable references and compliance constants updated to reflect the Upstash Redis naming convention.
acceptanceCriteria: frontend/.env.example replaces KV_REST_API_URL with UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_URL
frontend/.env.example replaces KV_REST_API_TOKEN with UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_TOKEN
frontend/.env.example comment updated from 'Vercel KV' to 'Upstash Redis'
frontend/src/lib/ampre/compliance.ts comments referencing KV are updated to reference Redis
No references to KV_REST_API_URL or KV_REST_API_TOKEN remain in any source file (grep from frontend/src/)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: The KV_LISTINGS_KEY and KV_SYNC_LOG_PREFIX constant names in compliance.ts can stay as-is — they refer to key-value storage keys, not the Vercel KV product. Renaming them would be churn.

userStories.title: Final verification — zero @vercel/kv references remain
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to verify the migration is complete with no remaining references to the deprecated package.
acceptanceCriteria: Grep for @vercel/kv across the entire frontend/ directory returns zero results
Grep for KV_REST_API_URL across the entire frontend/ directory returns zero results
Grep for KV_REST_API_TOKEN across the entire frontend/ directory returns zero results
npm run build completes with no type errors
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: This is a verification-only story — if previous stories passed correctly, this should pass with no code changes
